recipes.title: Honey Chipotle Chicken & Mac and Cheese

items.i: each smoked paprika, garlic powder and salt

steps: Chicken
Toss the chicken with chipotle paste, spices and oil, then air fry or bake at 200°C (400°F) for 15–18 minutes. Toss in honey and broil 2–3 minutes until sticky with crispy edges.
Mac and cheese
Cook the macaroni. In the pot, melt the cream cheese into the milk, stir in the cheddar and seasonings until smooth, then fold in the pasta.
Portion
Divide into 4 containers and top with parsley.
recipes.notes: Macros are the creator's, per container. His full recipes are only sent by DM ("comment RECIPES"), so ingredients, amounts and method here are estimated to match the photos and his descriptions. Tips from the creator: keep sauces and fresh salads separate, and add a splash of milk before reheating creamy dishes.

recipes.title: Crispy Tandoori Chicken, Chips & Creamy Coleslaw

items.i: each garlic powder, salt and chili powder
each paprika, garlic powder and salt
lemon juice, salt and chili flakes

steps: Marinate
Coat the chicken in yogurt, tandoori masala, spices and lemon juice; marinate 30 minutes or longer.
Chips
Toss the wedges with oil and seasoning and air fry or bake at 200°C (400°F) for 25 minutes until crisp.
Chicken
Air fry or bake the chicken at 200°C (400°F) for 18–20 minutes until charred at the edges.
Coleslaw
Mix the cabbage and onion with the yogurt, mayo, lemon, salt and chili flakes.
Portion
Divide between 4 containers, keeping the coleslaw cold and separate if possible.

recipes.title: Honey BBQ Chicken & Creamy Garlic Parmesan Potatoes

items.i: each smoked paprika, garlic powder and salt

steps: Potatoes
Toss the potatoes with oil, garlic powder and salt and air fry or roast at 200°C (400°F) for 20–25 minutes until golden.
Chicken
Season the chicken and air fry or bake 15–18 minutes, then toss with BBQ sauce and honey and return for 3 minutes to caramelize.
Creamy coating
Melt the cream cheese with the milk and parmesan into a sauce and toss with the potatoes.
Portion
Divide into 4 containers and finish with parmesan, chili flakes and parsley.

recipes.title: Creamy Garlic Butter Steak Bites with Tuscan Parmesan Rice

items.i: light cooking cream or evaporated milk
chicken stock to cook, parsley and chili flakes

steps: Rice
Cook the rice in stock with the sun-dried tomatoes and Italian herbs, then stir through parmesan and parsley.
Steak
Season the steak and sear in a very hot pan in batches; finish with butter and garlic, tossing to coat.
Sauce
Simmer the cream, parmesan and seasoning until thick.
Portion
Divide rice and steak into 4 containers and drizzle with the sauce.

recipes.title: Caramelized Onion Creamy Chicken with Lemon Herb Rice

items.i: each garlic powder, paprika and salt
light cooking cream or evaporated milk

steps: Onions
Cook the onions slowly in butter for 20–25 minutes until deep golden and jammy.
Chicken
Season and sear the chicken until browned and cooked through.
Sauce
Add the cream and parmesan to the onions, simmer until thick, then stir in the chicken.
Rice
Cook the rice and toss with butter, lemon zest and juice, parsley and chili flakes.
Portion
Divide between 4 containers; add a splash of milk before reheating to loosen the sauce.

recipes.title: Chilli Lime Chicken Bowls with Coconut-Crusted Potatoes & Mango Salsa

items.i: each garlic powder, smoked paprika and salt

steps: Chicken
Marinate the chicken in the spices, lime, honey and oil, then air fry or bake at 200°C (400°F) for 18–20 minutes.
Potatoes
Toss the potatoes with spray, coconut, paprika and salt and air fry or roast until golden and crisp.
Salsa
Mix the mango, onion, pepper, cilantro, lime juice and salt.
Portion
Divide into 4 containers, keeping the salsa cold.
